title: Sulfur Cube Transparency Fix
description: Fixes the rendering of transparent blocks in Sulfur Cubes
body:
# Sulfur Cube Transparency Fix

Putting transparent blocks into a Sulfur Cube, e.g. with commands or with a mod, will result in a weird graphical issue where the inside is not rendered. This pack fixes this issue.
Unfortunately though, this has to remove transparency from the Sulfur Cube texture.

> Check out [Anything in Sulfur Cubes](https://modrinth.com/datapack/anything-in-sulfur-cubes) to put way more blocks in Sulfur Cubes with fitting properties, including transparent blocks!

![Image Comparison of Vanilla and this Fix.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RteWYduT/images/f752e3fc6c50add28f6a42bbce71353268d98fc1.png)
